column1: # Live thread dump from an Ignition gateway.
# JVM:      OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM (17.0.19+10-LTS mixed mode)
# 101 threads. This is exactly the set ThreadMXBean.getAllThreadIds()
# reports. The dump also held 13 VM-internal thread(s) with no
# java.lang.Thread.State line, which ThreadMXBean does not report;
# they are deliberately excluded. See scripts/discover_threads.py.
